title: The bot's lifecycle lives in four loose variables, and tick() keeps a halted flag beside sent === 'halt'
evidence: app/lib/youtube-bot.server.ts module state: isRunning, tickInFlight, cronIntervalId and firstTickId together encode stopped / armed / ticking, set and cleared in startYouTubeBot, stopYouTubeBot and runTick. One union (stopped; running with its timers; ticking) behind a pure transition() would hold it. tick() also sets `let halted = true` when postClaimed answers 'halt', only to skip processFollowUps: the same fact twice. Found in the C15 review (PR 1372); no behaviour change wanted
